title: Ombi
descript: Ombi is a self-hosted request management system for Plex, Emby and Jellyfin. Give friends and family their own login and let them request movies and TV shows from a clean web interface; approved requests can be handed to Sonarr or Radarr, Ombi tracks what is already available, and it can send notifications and newsletters. This app runs the LinuxServer.io Docker Hub image as a non-root container and keeps every setting, user and request in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Finish the first-run wizard to create the administrator account; the database, settings and logs stay in DockerAppData/ombidocker/config. Ombi is only the request front end: add your Plex, Emby or Jellyfin server and your Sonarr/Radarr servers under Settings, and make sure the container can reach them. The UI is plain HTTP - use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet. Back up config before removing the app with its data.
release_note: 1. First release: Ombi 4.53.10 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. The first-run wizard creates the administrator account, every setting and request stays in the application data folder, and the app opens from the TOS desktop icon.

data_notes: Everything Ombi writes lives in `/config`, mounted from `/Volume1/DockerAppData/ombidocker/config`: `Ombi.db` (users, requests), `OmbiSettings.db` (settings), `.aspnet/` (login keys) and `Logs/`. The container filesystem itself is disposable, and the image never needs to be modified.
design_notes: **The LinuxServer.io s6 init cannot run unprivileged.** The upstream image starts s6-overlay as root and drops to its `abc` user; inside a container that already runs as uid 1000 that init aborts (`s6-applyuidgid: unable to set supplementary group list`). `src/entrypoint.sh` therefore starts the Ombi binary directly with the same arguments as the upstream s6 service (`--storage /config --host http://*:3579`) and keeps `HOME`, `TMPDIR` on writable paths.

**One volume, one port, no extra privileges.** Only `/config` is persistent and only container port 3579 is published; no Docker socket, no camera or USB passthrough, no `privileged`, no host networking.

**Base URL / reverse-proxy sub-path is not supported.** Ombi writes its base URL into `wwwroot/index.html`, which is root-owned inside the image and stays read-only for a non-root container; serve it from a dedicated host name or sub-domain instead of a path prefix.
limitations: - Ombi is a request front end only: a Plex, Emby or Jellyfin server and (for automatic fulfilment) Sonarr/Radarr must already exist on your network.
- The web interface is served over plain HTTP on the published port; use a TLS reverse proxy if you expose it outside your LAN.
- Sub-path hosting (Ombi `Base URL`) is not supported by this package because the image stores it in a file the non-root container cannot write; use a dedicated host name.
- Email notifications and newsletters require an SMTP account configured under Settings; no mail server is bundled.
- The data folder is not visible in TOS File Manager; back it up over SMB/SSH or add it to a TOS backup task by path.

wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: the LinuxServer.io image starts s6-overlay as root, which cannot run inside a non-root container, so the compose file replaces the entrypoint with `src/entrypoint.sh`. It starts the Ombi binary directly with the upstream service's arguments (`--storage /config --host http://*:3579`) and only keeps using writable paths for `HOME` and `TMPDIR`.
user_mode_text: 上游镜像以 root 启动 s6-overlay 再降权到 abc；容器已是非 root 时 s6 无法启动 → 内联 entrypoint 直接启动 Ombi 二进制
user_mode_cons:
- 官方 LinuxServer.io 镜像默认 root + s6，TOS 禁止 root，因此覆盖 entrypoint：
  按上游 s6 服务的同样参数直接启动 `Ombi --storage /config --host http://*:3579`，
  并把 `HOME`/`TMPDIR` 指到可写路径；不修改镜像内容。
